minimal_ww_counterexample.explanation: two write quorums (each reaching write_quorum=1) are node-disjoint; concurrent writes can both commit without a common node, so their ordering is undecidable

minimal_rw_counterexample.explanation: a read quorum (read_quorum=1) and a write quorum (write_quorum=1) are node-disjoint; a read can miss a committed write entirely (stale read)
